blocks.html: Equipment and appliances installed at grade level shall be supported on a level concrete slab or other approved material extending not less than 3-inches (76.2 mm) above adjoining grade or shall be suspended not less than 6 inches (152.4 mm) above adjoining grade. Such supports shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
